subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this memory-specific `MemoryRerankProvider` SDK seam with a `memoryRerankProviders` manifest gate and single exclusive slot, or choose a different reranker contract?
rationale: The code path is reviewable and proof-backed, but accepting a new public plugin API and manifest contract is durable product/API direction that automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve narrow v1 seam after rebase
options.body: Accept the no-core-config, builtin-only exclusive-slot seam and require the branch to rebase cleanly while preserving current main behavior before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape
options.body: Ask for a keyed/provider-selected or more generic capability declaration before merge if the memory-specific deprecated-contract pattern is not the desired long-term API.

options.title: Defer to alternative reranker work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the broader external-reranker plugin/config direction instead of adding this core SDK seam now.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow v1 seam after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the no-core-config, builtin-only exclusive-slot seam and require the branch to rebase cleanly while preserving current main behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent memory/plugin surface history and is already connected to adjacent memory-corpus and reranker cluster work.
